root_cause.classification: deterministic mechanical source defect introduced by the v3.4 change (defect D7)
root_cause.exception: TypeError: int() argument must be a string, a bytes-like object or a number, not 'NoneType'
root_cause.why: the `none` text encoder reports context_dim() == None. The expression was guarded only by hasattr(encoder, 'context_dim'), not by a None check, so the run crashed while writing prompt_statistics_metadata.json AFTER training and prediction had already succeeded.
root_cause.why_only_gpt2_miflu_passed: gpt2_miflu is the only family in the gate that runs with --text-encoder gpt2, whose context_dim() returns a real integer (768). Every other family uses --text-encoder none.
root_cause.impact_scope: artifact-writing only; training, validation prediction, full-horizon metrics and checkpoint save/restore all completed before the failing line. No scientific input, metric definition or checkpoint was affected.

minimal_repair_required_before_any_resub.suggested_form: cd = encoder.context_dim() if hasattr(encoder, 'context_dim') else None; "context_dim": (int(cd) if cd is not None else None)
then_required_by_protocol: preserve the old source and diff
bump the implementation source version (v3.4 -> v3.5)
re-run the complete model-free test suite
rebuild the source snapshot and aggregate SHA-256
build the bundle twice and require identical hashes
deploy to a NEW isolated root (never overwrite v3_4)
re-run exactly one pre-Screening Gate and require 8/8
